title: Normalized floor-cell remainders cut the run-type budget below θ on E_run(10^6)
statement: Exact Juggler cell geometry forces finance-relevant odd or even remainders away from the top of their square/cube cells often enough that Σ w_i ε_i ≤ B_strict < budget_rhs, excluding at least one leftover in E_run(10^6), in particular L=25781 or L=55293.
counterexamples: OOE-legal n=1016445 in [10^6+1, 10^6+20001) has pos=0.9999737 and usable=0.9999737. The cell-top logarithm is attained on an exact cheap-valley start
62 OOE-legal starts in that window have pos≥0.988, the uniform factor L=55293 would need. 56 have pos≥0.99. OE-scale starts reach pos=0.99996 and even landings reach 0.99989
The observed maximum as a uniform factor excludes none of the 99 survivors. The window-mean usable 0.492 would exclude 49 lengths, but that average is not a CycleMin theorem
notes: pos and usable are local_defect plus the existing cell-top log bound. Even terms at n^2 do not bind. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: odds in [10^6+1, 10^6+20001) and [oe_start_min(10^6+1), oe_start+8000); 99 run-type survivors; spotlights L=25781 and 55293
